ware.guildmark.carriers_warrant.tip: A sealed bond of good name from the hall: with it you may take consignments, relief and feast tickets, and have a Carriers' Store raised for you.
ware.guildmark.carriers_warrant_again.ti: A Warrant that was lost, copied out of the hall's book and sealed again, free of charge.
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.deliverie: Deliveries made (a consignment counts 2, a relief 3)
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.warrant: The Carrier's Warrant (60 Marks at the hall's counter)
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.store: A Carriers' Store of your own
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.stall: A table or a pitch in another capital
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.house: A Counting House of your own
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.trust: Be Trusted at a capital first
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.known: Be Known at three capitals first
Be Known at every open capital first
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.none: You hold no Warrant to copy
message.guildmark.trade.rung.hawker: You are a Hawker now: three tickets at a time, and a harness and a donkey from the hall's counter.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.chapman: You are a Chapman now: consignments, relief and feast tickets are yours to take, four tickets at a time.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.factor: You are a Factor now: six tickets at a time, three guards, and the Store's bonded goods and half rent on your tables.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.house: You are Trader of the House now: eight tickets at a time, and carters of your own on the road.
message.guildmark.trade.warrant.read: The hall's book has you down as a %s with %s deliveries to your name, and this Warrant is the hall's word for it.
message.guildmark.trade.warrant.unknown: The hall's book has no Warrant under your name, so this sheet is only paper.
advancements.guildmark.chapman.title: Chapman
advancements.guildmark.chapman.descripti: Win the hall's trust: a Carrier's Warrant, sealed for a carrier of good name.
advancements.guildmark.factor.title: Factor
advancements.guildmark.factor.descriptio: Have a Carriers' Store raised in one town and keep a table or a pitch in another.
advancements.guildmark.trading_house.des: Have a Counting House raised, and send carters out under your own colours.
bonus.guildmark.word_fresh: %s hours fresher news from the other towns
bonus.guildmark.road_wary: %s wariness on the road (the Hunt finds your loads that much less often)
